name: Introduction to the OT Practice Process

assessments.name: Placement: Cognitive Stimulation Therapy online training
assessments.description: Online modules are pre-requisite training videos with quiz questions. Watching the videos is essential for attending the in-person workshop. Modules will be available earlier for self-paced completion.

assessments.name: Activity Form
assessments.description: Accurate record of placement hours and details is submitted.

assessments.name: Practice education skills portfolio
assessments.description: You will demonstrate defined year 1 level clinical skills. Domains include professional behaviour; self-management; communication skills; working in a team & role of OT

assessments.name: ACE interview
assessments.description: Accelerate Communication Excellence (ACE) interview - various times - see ACE Canvas site

assessments.name: Case Study Part 1 - Foundations
assessments.description: First three criteria of case study assignment (foundations). One student in the team submits PDF of up to 6 slides with speaking notes

assessments.name: Case Study Part 2 - Peer Feedback
assessments.description: You will be randomly allocated 2 submissions of Part 1 – Foundations. You will use the ‘Part 1’ rubric to provide feedback for each submission, including constructive comments that might improve the submission.

assessments.name: Placement: Cognitive Stimulation Therapy in-persontraining
assessments.description: In-person training where students consolidate skills from the online modules and extend skills with practical application of learning, ready for use in placements.

assessments.name: Placement briefing & debriefing sessions
assessments.description: Attendance at briefing sessions, de-briefing sessions, placement sites and clinical education sessions to meet 60 hours of fieldwork

assessments.name: Case Study Part 4b - Communication Skills - Q&A following presentation
assessments.description: Communication skills (dynamic): Q&A about case study following presentation
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement

assessments.name: Placement letter of introduction
assessments.description: Submission of letter of introduction to placement site clinical educator.

assessments.name: Case Study Part 4a - Communication Skills
assessments.description: Verbal communication skills during the presentation - professional communication to peers.

assessments.name: Case Study Part 3 - OT Formulation
assessments.description: Team presentation for 20 minutes of whole case study to class mates. PDF of slides and speaking notes to be submitted. Marked live in tutorial class times in Week 13.
assessments.length: 20 min per team; PDF of slides submitted
